newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Koch in $70 mln Venezuela chemical joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Koch in $70 mln Venezuela chemical joint venture.

text.p: Koch International signed Wednesday a $70 million petrochemicals joint venture in Venezuela, state owned oil company PdVSA said.

Koch has taken a 35 percent stake in the project that will produce 132,000 tonnes of propylene. PdVSA subsidiary Proesca has also taken a 35 percent stake, while leading local foods company Polar and oil services group Inelectra have each taken 15 percent.
Production at the plant in western Venezuela, next to PdVSA's 300,000 barrels per day (bpd) Cardon refinery, is slated to begin in early 1999, Polar representative Hernan Anzola told reporters.
